findings.title: Pharmacy Location Differs from Hospital Location
findings.detail: The pharmacy bill is from a chemist in Noida, whereas the hospital and treatment occurred in Bengaluru.

findings.title: Ward Day Mismatch in Discharge Summary
findings.detail: The discharge summary states the patient was shifted to the ward on day 3 of admission (18 Nov 2024), but the hospital bill charges for 2 days of ICU and 2 days of Semi-Private room.

quotes.quote: Shifted to the ward on day 3 of admission and remained stable in the ward until discharge.

findings.title: Pharmacy Bill Medications Differ from Prescription
findings.detail: Medications listed on the pharmacy invoice do not match the medications prescribed on the discharge prescription.

findings.title: Lab Report Dates Fall Outside Stay or Match Discharge Date
findings.detail: Laboratory reports are dated 20 Nov 2024, which is the discharge date, while some tests typically performed at admission are dated on discharge.

quotes.quote: Report Date 20 Nov 2024 Referring Doctor Dr. M. Iyer

findings.title: Identity Details Consistent Across Documents
findings.detail: No identity discrepancies found across the files.
